internal: Fruits and Vegetable item 1: taking the old one off, site work rather than a coating we supply. Put a rate on it or take it out.
Fruits and Vegetable item 2: offered IBTMAX B 1K against "Supply and apply of waterproofing using BASF MasterSeal M866". A polyurethane waterproofing membrane under the screed.
Fruits and Vegetable item 3: no product in our range is set against it. 75mm of sand and cement with steel mesh is builders work, not a coating.
Fruits and Vegetable item 4: no product in our range is set against it. Reinforcement steel, not a coating.
Fruits and Vegetable item 5: offered BT-Crete SL against "Supply and apply of Ucret HFl00 RT System @ 6mm". Ucrete, spelled as the bill spells it. Our PU cement mortar is BT-Crete SL.

Fruits and Vegetable item 6: offered BT-Crete SL against "Supply and apply of 200 mm covered skirting using Ucrete RG with champher and sealant for the termination". Ucrete is a polyurethane cement screed for food processing floors. BT-Crete SL is ours: a PU cement mortar for the food industry, food processing and kitchens. It is the same product under a different name.
Fruits and Vegetable item 6 is measured in lm, so the products’ per-m² cost was not applied; work that rate out by hand.
Fruits and Vegetable item 7: no product in our range is set against it. A jointing system with a steel cover. We supply the coating, not the joint. Price it in or take it out.
